slots.setting: an outdoor ski hut terrace on a snowy mountainside for cute animals

slots.background_tones: crisp (soft snow white, pale blue shadows, pale pine)
slots.kitchen: a small wooden ski hut serving window with snow on its roof

slots.counter: a pale pine outdoor bar counter with a light dusting of snow on its front edge
